description: §7.3.5 (S480) clean neg — no W-UNUSED-BINDING: every arm binder is read (`w` as the arm's value, `why` in a block arm, `r` / `h` in a `<match>` arm's interpolation, `w` in an attribute) or written `_` / `_`-prefixed (`.Circle(_)`, `_h`, the `!{}` wildcard `_`).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S480-unused-binding-six (item 2: arm binders reported; "`.A(_)` is the cheap fix")
rationale: §7.3.5: an arm binder is reported only when "nothing in the arm reads" it; "The fix is `_` in its place (`.V(_)`; `_` for `_ err`), or a `_`-prefixed name." A reference in a markup interpolation `${x}` or an attribute value counts as a read.
